items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: Well, yeah, he used to come up to White Plains.

ctx.x: And Max Cominsky you said you knew, didn't he?

Well, yeah, he used to come up to White Plains. And sometimes he'd come up. Did you record? And some other boys came up to, I can't remember, oh, the tenor man, Babe Russon used to come up. Oh, yeah? Yeah, Babe Russon used to come up.
And there was Ham Russon too.
